[[White Tiger]]s, differing from [[Tiger]]s only in color, are [[charmable animal]]s found wandering in the [[Echovald Forest]].

==Notes==
*A level 15 [[Elder]] White Tiger spawns in [[Melandru's Hope]], southwest of [[Jade Flats (Kurzick)]], ready to be charmed by [[Salke Fur Friend]]. Flagging [[hero]]es to the mob's patrol route and then getting just inside of radar range, it is possible to have them kill the mobs there, allowing the player to charm the pet after it is all over.
*White Tigers deal [[slashing damage]].
*[[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Cantha)''
* Certain [[White Mantle Champion]]s and [[White Mantle Scout]]s during the [[War in Kryta]] [[spawn]] a [[level]] 15 pet Elder White Tiger using [[Charm Animal (White Mantle)|Charm Animal]] rather than charming an existing one.
